_about: Input of `behaviour import`, not generated. The values BDS itself uses for custom blocks and items that do not set a component, each with the BDS evidence it was captured from. Never guess or hand-write a value: an entry needs a direct BDS source (NATIVE, SCRIPT_API or WIRE) and a reference naming the capture. Without an entry the default of a key is unknown (Provenance.Source.UNKNOWN_DEFAULT). Entry: {"key": "block:friction", "value": 0.6, "source": "NATIVE", "reference": "what captured it"}.
